text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
I was watching your training session.
You really seem to be working hard.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Keep up the good work,
and continue to guide <nickname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The proprietress praised our training session!
It seems she views us favorably.
